title: Evaluation after hardwiring inputs
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n+m$ input vertices, let $y$ assign Boolean values to the last $m$ inputs, and let $x$ assign values to the first $n$. Evaluating the circuit obtained by hardwiring $y$ gives the same output as evaluating $C$ on the concatenated assignment $(x,y)$.
hypotheses_covered: $y$ assigns Boolean values to the last $m$ inputs
$x$ assigns Boolean values to the first $n$ inputs
